about: The scheduled alert check's decisions both engines must agree on (QV-639). Written by make-alerts-run.py; see that file.

cases.name: oldest checked first: never, then 20 min ago, then 10 min ago
the budget: no workspace starts once it has passed; the rest wait
a budget of 0: nothing is checked
leases: held by another check, or checked fine within the gap, is skipped; an ended lease or a failed check within the gap is not
channels: a workspace with rules and no channel is skipped; one without rules is not counted
a dashboard rule fires and is sent
a dashboard rule still critical: recorded, not sent again
a rule fires on a new message after the quiet period
muted: it fires, the state is recorded, nothing is sent
snoozed: it resolves, the state is recorded, nothing is sent
a snooze that ended: still firing sends one change, since the rule began firing
a snooze that ended on a quiet rule: it resolves and nothing is sent
a snooze that ended on a rule that fires again now: the usual change, no second one
a failing workspace is recorded with its error and doesn't stop the others
no rules anywhere: nothing is read
